owner: Société d'Infrastructures Numériques (SIN) / Republic of Togo
notes: Official site describes Lomé Data Centre as Togo's first carrier-neutral Tier III+ data center, operated by SIN, serving enterprises, ISPs, mobile operators and cloud operators; official site lists power capacity as 1+ MW. Togo First reported the government inauguration in Lomé on 2021-06-04; PeeringDB lists the facility in Lomé and operator SIN.
